subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly in Telegram plain-group route persistence, through a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or only after a fresh live Telegram restart reproduction separates transcript persistence from route metadata?
rationale: The visible source gap is Telegram-specific, but related non-direct session issues show a shared fallback could alter cross-channel routing and session-state behavior.

options.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
options.body: Persist the Telegram plain-group last route for accepted group turns, add focused Telegram regression coverage, and leave the shared fallback to the separate cross-channel issue until it has compatibility proof.

options.title: Adopt a shared fallback
options.body: Refresh or replace the shared fallback PR after proving Mattermost, Telegram, and existing session-key contracts are preserved across upgrades.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until a current-main Telegram plain-group restart test proves whether the remaining failure is route metadata, transcript persistence, cleanup, or expected ambient-room behavior.

recommendation.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
recommendation.body: Persist the Telegram plain-group last route for accepted group turns, add focused Telegram regression coverage, and leave the shared fallback to the separate cross-channel issue until it has compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder and last-route behavior that this person introduced and later maintained.
